title: Hormone Yoga in Coburg | Yoga Momente
description: Hormone yoga in Coburg after Dinah Rodrigues: for menopause, thyroid, cycle and vitality. Course or single class with Susanne Müller, on demand.

sections.title: Hormone Yoga
sections.lead: Vitality for women and men: bring body and hormonal system into balance.

sections.title: Hormone Yoga: what to expect.
paragraphs: Based on the proven system of Dinah Rodrigues, dynamic body exercises are combined with special breathing techniques and visualizations that regulate the glandular system. Anti-stress and relaxation exercises harmonize body and mind. For balancing the hormonal system, for example menopause symptoms, thyroid or prostate problems, and for younger women from 35 with cycle disorders, PMS or an unfulfilled wish for a child.

items.title: When and where
items.text: Currently not offered at a fixed time but on demand: as its own course or as a single class. Write to us and we will find a time.

items.title: Price
items.text: 3 participants: €200, 4 participants: €150 per person, hormone booklet included.

sections.title: Start with a trial class.
sections.text: One trial class of 60 minutes for €60. Write to us and we will arrange your appointment.
